# uptimeify_im_routing_rule (Data Source)

Read one Incident Management routing rule by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_im_routing_rule" "db" {
  id = "17"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric rule id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `match` (Attributes) What the rule matches; all set fields must match. Unset or `{}` = catch-all. All ids must belong to the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `priority` (Number) Lower runs first. Default `100`.
- `severity_override` (String) Unset = keep the mapped severity.
- `team_id` (Number) The team that receives matching incidents.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Read-Only:

- `customer_ids` (List of Number) Customer ids. At most 500.
- `field_matches` (Map of String) Payload field -> expected value, at most 50 entries.
- `monitor_ids` (List of Number) Ids of any monitor type (website, DNS, ICMP, ...). At most 500.
- `severity` (List of String) `sev1` to `sev4`.
- `source_ids` (List of Number) Alert source ids. At most 500.
- `tags` (List of String) Alert tags. At most 200.
